name: USGS Point Buchon interpreted CMECS seafloor polygons

rights.license: USGS public domain with source and metadata attribution

temporal.update_cadence: Monthly original-archive hash, schema, topology and private-block aggregate review

evidence.supports: USGS describes 2 m backscatter/bathymetry-derived and video-supervised geologic interpretation, public-domain use, unquantified polygon boundary accuracy and variable video positioning.
Inspected shapefile has 193,015 polygons and five substrate codes; some polygons inside private candidate envelopes have invalid topology.

limitations: CMECS polygons reuse acoustic and video inputs from the Point Buchon map family; they cannot count as independent habitat groundtruth against the paired USGS character raster.
Publisher cannot quantify polygon-boundary accuracy. Camera positions are highly variable around 10 m; 2 m raster derivation is not 2 m boundary certainty.
The inspected archive contains 193,015 polygons, while an overview line in the included XML says 66,987; use the inspected file count and hold an unexplained revision.
Invalid polygons may intersect reviewed research blocks; excluded valid-only area is incomplete, and absence of a valid bedrock polygon is not evidence of soft bottom.
No MLLW depth, total upper error, independent fish evidence, full legal/chart/route clearance, ranking or export is supplied by this source.

producer.name: U.S. Geological Survey, Pacific Coastal and Marine Science Center

provenance.access_service: USGS CMGDS static shapefile release, version 1.1 January 2024
transformations: Inspect original shapefile fields and topology before any spatial comparison; do not repair invalid boundaries without review.
Intersect valid source polygons with private 100 m research blocks only and publish aggregate substrate areas without block coordinates.
Keep this same-lineage lithology refinement separate from independent bottom-camera or grab evidence; do not promote a fishing spot.
